blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Once again, Lawrence Mangubat provided the late heroics for Jose Rizal University. With Mangubat showing nerves of steel, the Heavy Bombers outlasted the Letran Knights, 102-98, in overtime to take Game 1 of their NCAA Season 102 Final Four series on Monday night at Mall of Asia Arena. Mangubat hit the clutch 3-pointer from the top of the key that gave JRU its first taste of the lead, 100-98, with 8.2 seconds remaining.
